# acme-kit-go

Import the packages under `hop.top/kit/go/core/upgrade` and `hop.top/kit/go/core/redact`.

To pick another port, open [acme-kit](https://example.test/acme/kit/blob/main/skills/acme-kit/SKILL.md).

## Open when

| File | Open when |
|---|---|
| [references/coverage.md](references/coverage.md) | checking whether a capability exists in this port |
| [references/other-ports.md](references/other-ports.md) | the task belongs to another language |
| [scripts/detect.sh](scripts/detect.sh) | the language of the project is not known |
| [references/cli-and-console.md](references/cli-and-console.md) | the task touches the command line surface |
| [assets/snippets/hello/hello.go](assets/snippets/hello/hello.go) | starting a new Go command from a working example |
